listing.name: TTS for Fish Audio
listing.description: Speech for the assistant from Fish Audio: s2.1-pro and other models, public and your own voices.
config.api_key.title: Fish Audio API key
config.api_key.description: A key from https://fish.audio/app/api-keys/. Used for both synthesis and the voice list.
config.model.title: TTS model
config.model.description: s2.1-pro is the production model, s2.1-pro-free is the same model at no cost for testing. s1 is deprecated and will be served by s2.1-pro on 2026-12-31.
config.latency.title: Response time
config.latency.description: normal — best quality, balanced — lower latency, low — as fast as possible.
config.mp3_bitrate.title: Audio bitrate
config.mp3_bitrate.description: 128 kbps by default. 64 kbps makes the reply smaller — helps when the connection drops large audio (VPN, anti-virus, a TLS-intercepting proxy).
config.language.title: Language for reading numbers and dates
config.language.description: For example ru or en. Only changes how numbers, dates and units are spelled out; it does not change the voice. Leave empty to detect it automatically.
